vibe: Cinematic, opulence, immersive 3D, fine-dining mysticism. Merges culinary art with cutting-edge tech (AI) in a dark, moody environment.

rules: No pure whites except for primary text. No generic grays; always tint with warmth.
Use #D4AF37 (Molten Gold) strictly as a highlight color (CTAs, active states, key icons).
Surfaces must rely on 1px borders (border-white/5 or border-[#D4AF37]/20) and glassmorphism rather than heavy drop shadows.
Headings: Cormorant Garamond, tracking-tight, font-light or font-medium. Use lowercase for poetic subheadings.
Labels/Overlines: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-[10px] or text-xs, text-brand-primary.
Max Heading Size: text-6xl for hero, text-4xl/5xl for section headers.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Use Mode A (The 'Tetris' Grid) for galleries and menu highlights. High asymmetry. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-16).
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Components should have ample breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Offset alignments. Do not center everything. Stagger images and text blocks.
spacing_and_layout.hero: Full-bleed (100vh). Must include heavy overlay (bg-black/60) over any background imagery to preserve text contrast.

surfaces_and_fx.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header, AI chatbot modal, and reservation form. `backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]`
surfaces_and_fx.tracing_beam: Apply subtle glowing gradient borders to signature dish cards on hover.
surfaces_and_fx.hover_states: Images scale gently (scale-105). Text shifts to primary color. Buttons get a soft gold drop-shadow.
surfaces_and_fx.animations: Framer Motion for scroll reveals (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> 1, duration 0.8s, ease: 'easeOut'). Staggered lists for menu items.

components.header: Sticky nav, glassmorphism. Logo centered, links flanking. 'Reserve' CTA button (solid gold bg, black text).
components.hero: Cinematic text reveal. Background features abstract 3D gold particles or slow-moving video-like texture. Scroll indicator (mouse or arrow down).
components.menu_gallery: Bento grid or asymmetrical list. Hovering over menu item reveals image via tooltip/floating image (Framer Motion) or cross-fades.
components.reservation_form: Shadcn Form, highly customized. Dark inputs (`bg-black/50`, `border-white/20`, focus:`border-[#D4AF37]`). Include DatePicker and Select (time/guests).
components.ai_chatbot: Fixed bottom-right FAB. Opens a chat interface (Shadcn Dialog/Card). 'Speak to the Executive Chef AI'. Neon/gold glowing avatar.
components.testimonials: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Large, elegant serif text drifting slowly horizontally.

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D gold particles. Use as a full-screen background with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/60) for the hero section.

chef_portrait.description: Chef portrait in dark background. Use for the 'Chef's Story' section.

signature_dish_1.description: Gourmet steak dinner on dark plate.

signature_dish_2.description: Luxurious chocolate dessert on dark wood, high contrast.

signature_dish_3.description: Elegant display of gourmet dishes artfully arranged.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Framer Motion (`yarn add framer-motion`) and React Fast Marquee (`yarn add react-fast-marquee`).
Install lucide-react (if not present) for elegant, simple icons.
Theme is exclusively dark mode. Remove standard Vercel/Shadcn boilerplate colors and implement the deep black/gold palette specified.
In the Hero section, implement the `hero_background` image with a parallax effect using Framer Motion (or simple CSS `background-attachment: fixed`), and add an overlay so the gold text pops.
Implement the 'AI Chef Recommendation Chatbot' as a fixed widget in the bottom right corner. Make it look like a high-end command interface, not a standard support bubble.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Use standard Tailwind utilities; do not over-rely on Shadcn for structural layouts (use raw flex/grid). Only use Shadcn for complex logic (Forms, Select, Dialog for the Chatbot).
For the Menu section, use an asymmetrical bento grid displaying the `signature_dish` images.
